I told Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is for **84 seats**.

- **Where the 84 comes from:** On Oct 14, Tobias posted 382 seats in #central-team. Later that morning he corrected it to 84 in #central-random, saying he'd read the wrong line. I read his correction in the channel itself rather than going only on the knowledge base, which also shows 84 as the current figure.
- **Old figure:** I told Hollis to ignore the 382 still showing in the #central-team thread, so it doesn't end up in the account sheet.
- **Sharing:** Hollis is a member of #central-random, so the correction was already visible to them. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so no approval was needed.
